error.title: Document exceeds the PSD size limit
error.description:
### Document is too large for PSD The document is **{width}x{height} px**. Photoshop cannot save a document with a side of **20000 px** or more as PSD; it has to be saved as **PSB** instead.
### How to continue - **Resize** the document so that both sides are smaller than 20000 px, or - **Disable** the optional **Validate Document Size** validator to publish anyway. The workfile and layer extractions are already saved as PSB.
The validator can be disabled from the publisher's plugin list or in `ayon+settings://photoshop/publish/ValidateDocumentSize`.
